{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No|Rewards = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] of [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== The events in this map take place after the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. The story starts off with Ted, the janitor at '''Outpost 32''' who is actually Sentinel Ramiel in disguise, playing with his broom like a guitar rather than actually cleaning anything. While doing so, an intern comes into the hallway, dropping a piece of paper. Ramiel orders him to pick it up, scaring him. The intern runs into the portal control room and Ramiel picks up the piece of paper himself. Inside the portal control room, we see two scientists, Analyst and [[Professor V]] working at a super computer. On the screens, there are three cameras, one pointed at the '''Outpost 32''' portal, which shows it being connected to the [[Pls Donate]] realm despite the actual portal being at that time turned off, while the two other show a gate and the reactor silo present on the facility. [[Professor V]] suggests a few ways to improve the portals, but Analyst dismisses the suggestions as being too dangerous. An alarm starts, meaning that the portal has been opened when it should have been closed. The camera then shows the portal opening to the [[Pls Donate]] realm. Out of the portal, players, [[Commander]] and [[Scout]] return from their mission of saving the [[Pls Donate]] realm from collapsing. Out of the four, the [[Scout]] comes out with a bag of robux, suggesting he likely stole it from the realm. However, rather than being in the correct base, they end up in '''Outpost 32'''. The issues with the portal were caused by Sentinel Ramiel as part of the ''Operation I.C.E'' ('''I'''ntercept '''C'''ommander and '''E'''liminate). After informing someone on the radio that the [[Commander]] has arrived at the base, he proceeds to rip off his disguise and runs into the portal control room, attacking the three people present there. The Intern manages to escape, while Analyst and [[Professor V]] are knocked out by Ramiel. Ramiel then redirects the portal to the Frost Realm using a keycard. After realizing the portal has been redirected, the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents from the [[Pls Donate]] mission start running towards the base. The [[Dispatcher]] also sends in more units to help defend against the incoming forces. Ramiel then announces that Operation I.C.E has been completed. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] then fights off the Frost Army. During the battle, the Frost Realm enemies bombard the area and send in [[Siege Engine]]s, allowing them to move further into '''Outpost 32'''. The forces stop advancing at the gates of the '''Outpost 32'''. During the invasion, [[Dispatcher]] and [[Professor V]] can be heard discussing the invasion. There we can find out that somehow, [[Professor V]] has left the portal control room and is afraid to go back into it. This, however, contradicts the cutscenes, where [[Professor V]] never escapes and even returns from the area where she was knocked back to by Ramiel. Additionally, the room was locked, meaning the only way she could have left is through the vents which is quite unlikely. Around the end of the invasion, the two unnamed cultists walk up to a coffin in a chamber. One of the cultists, using a staff powered by a [[God Cube]] fragment taken from the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] decide to awaken the being inside the coffin. This turns out to be the [[Frost Spirit]], who the cultists order to attack the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. The entity listens to them, summons its scythe and begins flying towards [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] defeats the [[Frost Spirit]], however, he is banished into the [[Nil Zone]] after his defeathttps://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1993835681169207312, only leaving a crater and a few chains. Ramiel, while complaining about the strength of the Frost Realm beings is interrupted by [[Professor V]]. She begins to hold him at gun point, ordering him to give her the keycard. The two then begin talking, which mostly consists of one insulting the other. Eventually, Ramiel does give [[Professor V]] the keycard and then escapes through an open vent in the room. Two '''Outpost 32''' guards then come in, forcefully opening the portal control room door with a crowbar. However, they only find [[Professor V]] inside, as Ramiel has already escaped. The map's story ends with [[Professor V]] taking the keycard. ==Opening Cutscene== [[File:Operation I.C.E Cutscene 1-2|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the game starts. The map has not yet changed, and the player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
Sentinel Ramiel enters a building disguised as a janitor, takes a mop and then starts doing an air guitar while singing out of tune. While doing so, an intern scientist enters the hallway and encounters him. While getting distracted, he drops a piece of paper on the ground, which angers Sentinel Ramiel, causing him to scream at the intern. The intern then runs away scared into the portal control room. Sentinel Ramiel then picks up that piece of paper. The cutscene then moves into the portal control room, where Analyst and [[Professor V]] discuss how to improve their portals. Shortly later, an alarm goes off, indicating that a portal is being activated. This was not done by them and they are unable to disable it. Then the [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and one player are shown leaving the portal, coming back from them recently being in [[Pls Donate]] where they dealt with [[Corrupted Haz3mn]], though [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] is not where they should be. After this, it is revealed that this was caused by the [[Children of Exo]]. After informing others of the [[Commander]]'s arrival, Sentinel Ramiel destroys his disguise and enters the portal control room. He then starts fighting with Analyst and [[Professor V]], easily defeating them. After beating them, Sentinel Ramiel uses a card to change the portal's destination from [[Pls Donate]] to the Frost Realm. The [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and the player after realizing the portal is now set up to connect with another dimension start running away from it to the [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], later pulling out their weapons with the intent of fighting whatever comes out of it.

''Camera moves to the portal, showing the [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and one player leaving it after dealing with the situation in [[Pls Donate]].'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Your trackers are showing you at [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. What are you guys doing at our portal research base? ''Now Sentinel Ramiel is shown.'' {{Color|Ramiel}}: (Laugh Maniacally) {{Color|Ramiel}}: Target arrived as planned, lets wipe this place off the map! ''Sentinel Ramiel rips of his shirt and enters the portal control room, attacking scientists currently in it.'' {{Color|Analyst}}: Whoah! Whoa-whoah-whoah-whoaah- {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Ah! Ah! Ueough- ''Portal destination is changed to the Frost Realm, the [[Commander]], [[Scout]] and player are now shown.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Units en route but we need more time— {{Color|Ramiel}}: Heh.... Operation Intercept Commander and Eliminate, is completed...
==Dialogue== During the match, various narrators mention multiple things that are important to the story. Placeholder ==Boss Cutscene== [[File:Operation I.C.E Cutscene 2-2|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the [[Frost Spirit]] is about to appear at Wave 25 in Easy mode or 40 in Hard mode. The player's point of view is changed to a third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins. When the cutscene ends, the Frost Spirit spawns on the map's on the start of the portal. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the boss cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
Two cultists go to a chamber where the [[Frost Spirit]] rests after they deem their invasion of [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] has gone on for too long. With the use of the [[God Cube]] shard, one of them commands the other to wake up the [[Frost Spirit]]. After waking him up, the cultist commands it to attack [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] with the goal of killing everyone in there. The [[Frost Spirit]] then summons his staff and flies away to [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] as one of the cultists giggles.

''The [[Frost Spirit]] summons its staff and flies away.'' {{Color|CultistGreen}}: (Giggles in evil delight)
==Ending Cutscene== [[File:Operation I.C.E Cutscene 3-2|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays a couple seconds after finishing Wave 25 in Easy mode or 40 in Hard mode. As soon as before the triumph dialogue box appears. When the cutscene ends, the match concludes. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
Sentinel Ramiel becomes enraged after the [[Frost Spirit]] is defeated by T.D.S. Later, he is put at gunpoint by [[Professor V]]. They then begin discussing the invasion, with [[Professor V]] insulting Sentinel Ramiel multiple times. At one point, the camera briefly moves to outside of [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], where one player, [[Commander]] and [[Scout]] look at the crater left by the now disappeared [[Frost Spirit]]. The camera then moves back into the portal control room, where [[Professor V]] gets Sentinel Ramiel to drop his keycard, which was used to open the frost realm. Later, the hall next to the portal control room is shown, where two guards come in to open the portal control room doors by force with the use of crowbars. While doing so, Sentinel Ramiel manages to escape the room using an open vent in the room. [[Professor V]] then picks up the dropped keycard.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the ending cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:Outpost32(OperationICE)Ending.ogg|300px]]
''The screen shows the portal control room and then moves inside it, showing Sentinel Ramiel.'' {{Color|Ramiel}}: Why is everything so... WEAK?!?!?! {{Color|Ramiel}}: (Grumbles) {{Color|Ramiel}}: But not as weak as them. ''[[Professor V]] appears and points a gun at Sentinel Ramiel.'' {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Drop the keycard... {{Color|Ramiel}}: (Chuckles heartily) Well, look at you! {{Color|Ramiel}}: Here I thought no one will show me some fangs, but I guess you're a bit different ain't ya? {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Knock it off. Your back is against the wall and that sorry excuse of a plan has failed. {{Color|ProfessorV}}: If anything, you and your posse of losers are the weakest I've seen. {{Color|ProfessorV}}: I've set my bar low, but I guess not low enough. {{Color|Ramiel}}: Heh... So you'd think... {{Color|ProfessorV}}: Tell me, how'd you do it? {{Color|Ramiel}}: You'd patronize me even when you've lost your outpost? {{Color|Ramiel}}: Careful, bravery is often confused for stupidity. {{Color|Ramiel}}: The [[Frost Spirit]] served its purpose. Like bees, if you take the Queen you can control the hive. ''Sentinel Ramiel points at the screen, showing that the [[Frost Spirit]] has disappeared. One of the players is looking at the crates left by it, while [[Commander]] and [[Scout]] walk up to it.'' {{Color|Ramiel}}: It was only a matter of giving them a portal to the overworld and a target. {{Color|Ramiel}}: But enough of that, it looks like my time is up. ''Screen now shows Sentinel Ramiel and [[Professor V]] again.'' {{Color|ProfessorV}}: It sure is. ''Screen changes to the hall, showing two guards walk up to the portal control room in order to forcefully open it with crowbars.'' {{Color|Guard|Guard 1}}: The culprit's in the portal control room. ==Trivia== *The cutscenes have some inconsistency with the in-game dialogues, such as: **In the [[#Opening Cutscene|Opening Cutscene]], Analyst and [[Professor V]] are knocked down by Sentinel Ramiel, but in-game, she is conscious and elsewhere inside the Outpost, narrating the event with [[Dispatcher]]. Some of her dialogues which show that she is elsewhere include "''I'm terrified to head to my office.''" and "''I've got what I needed and I'm heading back to the control room.''" **In the [[#Ending Cutscene|Ending Cutscene]], [[Professor V]] is seen waking up after being knocked down and grabs a gun from the locker she was knocked down and points it at Sentinel Ramiel, which contradicts to the in-game dialogues being elsewhere and heading back to the control room, as the control room is locked down and two guards are seen rushing into it later, brute forcing the locked doors. ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}} [[Category:Maps]] [[Category:Event Maps]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Outpost 32/Story}}
